methods.rain_indices: ETCCDI core climate-extremes indices (CDD, R20mm, Rx5day; wet day = 1 mm). https://etccdi.pacificclimate.org/list_27_indices.shtml
methods.crop_year_enso: project choice. NDJ sits in the middle of both pilots' summer-crop season; the phase and strength of that season come from CPC's own rules (config/enso.yaml).
methods.yield_anomaly: project choice. Linear detrending is the simplest widely used way to separate weather shocks from the yield trend in crop-climate studies; it is a first pass, to be revisited in Phase 4.
methods.ndvi: project choice. Peak months follow the summer-crop calendar in config/crops.yaml (itself `suposicao`); the validity thresholds keep cloudy composites out rather than trusting a few clear pixels.
methods.forecast: ETCCDI thresholds reused; comparison window = the forecast's own dates

enso_seasonal.parquet.baseline_oni: centered 30-year base periods updated every 5 years (CPC ONI v5)
enso_seasonal.parquet.baseline_roni: Nino-3.4 minus tropical-mean (20N-20S) SST anomaly, variance-rescaled (CPC)

power_daily.parquet.source: NASA POWER daily point API, community=AG
power_daily.parquet.grid_note: POWER values are grid-cell averages (~0.5 x 0.625 deg), not station data

pam.parquet.source: IBGE PAM via SIDRA API, tables 1612 (temporary crops) and 839 (maize by harvest)
pam.parquet.year_convention: harvest year (matches the project crop-year label)
pam.parquet.currency_note: production_value is nominal, in each year's currency (see unit)

regions.parquet.source: IBGE malhas API v3 (qualidade=intermediaria); US Census Bureau cartographic boundary file 2023 (1:500k)
regions.parquet.centroid_method: area-weighted polygon centroid, degrees lon/lat, full-resolution geometry

ndvi_composites.parquet.cropland_mask: stable cropland, io-lulc 2017-2023, fraction >= 0.5 every year

terrain.parquet.attribution: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA
terrain.parquet.relief_source: Embrapa (1979), Sumula da 10a Reuniao Tecnica de Levantamento de Solos; relief classes as reproduced in Santos et al., Manual de Descricao e Coleta de Solo no Campo (SBCS/Embrapa).
